title: Failover Pattern — Companion Code
description: Failover implementations across four layers: health-monitored active-passive manager, PostgreSQL connection failover, DNS-based failover, Nginx upstream backup, Kubernetes multi-cluster setup, JavaScript client, and active-active / cascading variants.
description_es: Implementaciones de failover en cuatro capas: gestor active-passive con health checks, failover de conexiones PostgreSQL, failover DNS, upstream de respaldo en Nginx, despliegue multi-clúster en Kubernetes, cliente JavaScript y variantes active-active / en cascada.
